Marcus: Starlane asked for a joint perf/W certification for S3 SoC to appear on marketplace. Can we stand this up next week?
Anya: Yes. Need NDA addendum for low-level telemetry + a 30-day retention window.
Raj: Kernel knobs to try: cpufreq=performance; disable turbo; transparent hugepages=always; irq pinning; iommu=pt if passthrough. Will prepare two configs: baseline + tuned.
Sophia: Workload: Llama-13B (fallback 7B) seq=1024; quant q4 and q8; batch sizes 1 and 8. Metrics: tokens/sec per watt, p95 latency, raw samples retained.
Lia: Marketing needs final verified CSV summary + logo clearance, allow 10 business days for marketplace listing.
Marcus: Proposed schedule: dry-run Mon 09:00 PT (smoke q4 run), partner lab Wed-Thu full sweep.
bench-bot: Smoke script uploaded: https://internal.redwood/bench/starlane/smoke.sh (private).
Raj: Measurement plan: warmup 120s, steady windows 6x5min, IPMI sampling 2s, external meter cross-check. Use 5% trimmed mean for reported power. Raw CSVs + artifact bundle required.
Anya: I'll draft runbook with telemetry schema, file naming, and legal addendum. Will request sample IPMI CSV from Starlane ahead of dry-run.
Marcus: Partner contact is Evan (evan@starlane.com). I'll intro him after runbook + NDA draft.
Sophia: Confirm dry-run Mon 09:00 PT?
Marcus: +1
Raj: +1
Anya: +1
